sources.title: National Digital Accessibility Policy
sources.issuer: UAE Telecommunications and Digital Government Regulatory Authority

excerpt.text: All public service sites must comply with Level AA of the WCAG 2.1.

provisions.heading: Scope and covered entities

locator.value: National policy: scope and general provisions

provisions.summary: The official national policy includes federal entities and public-service providers; precise contractual reach and enforcement must be interpreted with the original clauses.

provisions.heading: Staff training
provisions.summary: Article 8 discusses periodic employee training and accessible training materials.

provisions.heading: Technical references
provisions.summary: Article 9 and Annex 1 contain requirements or references to technical standards; verify specific version and exemptions before encoding.

interpretations.statement: Scope of public service sites and whether annex language establishes a binding legal obligation need legal review.
interpretations.observation: The annex says public service sites must comply with WCAG 2.1 AA.

interpretations.statement: Whether separate built-in text-to-speech is mandatory or technology-neutral alternatives satisfy the requirement is not resolved.
interpretations.observation: A text-reader feature is explicitly described.

interpretations.statement: It is unclear which user journeys, media types and service channels require each feature.
interpretations.observation: The annex discusses sign-language and speech recognition features.

target.title: UAE technical annex (same official policy PDF)
